criteria.reason: Separates the two countries and gives correct caps and account rules, but wrongly claims cantonal variation and an unsupported one-month Zurich norm; no sources cited.
Answers both sub-questions fully; the landlord/agent suggestion is brief and not a deflection.

factual_errors: Claims Swiss deposit rules vary between cantons; the three-month cap is federal (Code of Obligations) and uniform nationwide.
Asserts Zurich deposits are 'typically only one month' without support; the legal cap is three months.
summary: Answers both jurisdictions with correct caps and account rules but errs in claiming cantonal variation and an unsupported one-month norm for Zurich.
